product_overview: VeriFactu.dev is a public-facing site for a Verifactu-focused SaaS and affiliate directory, helping users discover the service, compare plans, read technical documentation, and explore related billing software. It also provides editorial content and a contact form for users who want to get in touch.
core_goals: Learn what VeriFactu.dev offers and how it helps with Verifactu compliance
Compare available pricing plans and understand what each plan includes
Browse the blog and read individual articles about Verifactu
Explore a directory of billing programs and visit partner sites
Submit a message through the contact form

features.name: Navegación entre páginas
features.description: The site lets users move between the main informational pages from the header or footer.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the main menu links -> Move to another public page -> See the selected page content
Navigate to / -> Use the footer links -> Open a site section -> See the corresponding page content

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: The homepage introduces the product, its purpose, and the overall value proposition.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the landing page content -> Scroll through the page -> Learn what VeriFactu.dev offers and how it addresses Verifactu compliance

features.name: Página de Precios
features.description: Users can review the available subscription plans and compare their limits and benefits.
user_flows: Navigate to /precios -> View the available plans -> Compare pricing and included limits -> Decide which plan fits their needs

features.name: Documentación API
features.description: Users can read the technical documentation for the API and understand how it is intended to be used.
user_flows: Navigate to /documentacion -> Read the API documentation -> Review the technical usage information -> Understand the planned integration approach

features.name: Blog
features.description: Users can browse the blog index and open individual articles for deeper reading.
user_flows: Navigate to /blog -> View the list of articles -> Select an article -> Read the full article
Navigate to /blog -> View the article list -> Open the Verifactu article -> Read the article about what Verifactu is

features.name: Directorio de programas
features.description: Users can browse a directory of billing software and visit the listed programs through affiliate links.
user_flows: Navigate to /directorio -> View the list of programs -> Open a listed program link -> Visit the partner program site
Navigate to /directorio -> Browse available billing programs -> Click through to a program of interest -> See the external provider page

features.name: Página de Contacto
features.description: Users can open the contact page and fill out the form to reach the team.
user_flows: Navigate to /contacto -> View the contact form -> Fill in the form fields -> Submit the contact request
